quick_brief: Challenge of the sixth and final week: Test your highly advanced skills in linking your applications with the latest generative artificial intelligence models ChatGPT and generating art paintings with ImageBot!

questions.text: What is the Advanced AI Component in App Inventor that allows your app to be connected to ChatGPT AI models for intelligent text conversations?
Which programming function do we use to send the user's text question to the ChatGPT AI servers to get the answer?
Which throw event is automatically executed once the application successfully receives the ChatGPT AI answer and displays it to the user?
What is the specialized artificial intelligence tool (Component) that generates amazing paintings and images just by describing them in text in English?
Which software function do we use to send the text description of the scene (Prompt) to generate the magic image with ImageBot?
Which throwing event is automatically executed once the image generation is completed successfully and reaches the user's phone?
In the ImageCreated(image) event, which property of the ImageComponent do we assign the generated image to appear to the user on the screen?
To create an intelligent assistant application that listens to the user's questions and speaks the answer audio, we combine the artificial intelligence ChatGPT with utilities:
What is the technical term (Prompt) used in the world of artificial intelligence to express the textual description that the user writes to direct the machine to design an image or write text?
What is the fundamental benefit of using generative AI within smartphone applications?
options: Make the application smart, interactive, and capable of understanding and generating complex content instantly
Speed ​​up the loading of the login screen
questions.correct: Make the application smart, interactive, and capable of understanding and generating complex content instantly

questions.text: Write the code to send the question written in TextBox1 to the AI ​​expert ChatBot1 when the submit button is clicked.
questions.correct_code:
when Button_Send.Click
do call ChatBot1.PostText (question = get TextBox1.Text)

questions.text: Write code to receive the image generated in the ImageCreated event and set it as an image for an item named Image_Result.
questions.correct_code:
when ImageBot1.ImageCreated (image)
do set Image_Result.Picture to get image
